items.text: I find visiting an art museum boring.
I plan and organize things in advance so that I am not rushed at the last minute.
I rarely hold grudges, even against people who have treated me badly.
Overall, I am fairly satisfied with myself.
I would feel afraid if I had to travel in severe weather.
Even if flattery would help me obtain a reward, I would not use it.
I enjoy learning about the history and politics of other countries.
I usually push myself hard to achieve my goals.
Sometimes people tell me that I am too critical of others.
I rarely express my opinions in group discussions.
Sometimes I become anxious about small things without intending to.
If I knew I could never be caught, I would be tempted to steal one million yuan.
I enjoy creating art, such as writing stories or songs and painting.
When doing things, I tend not to pay much attention to small details.
Sometimes other people think that I am too stubborn.
Compared with working alone, I prefer work that involves active interaction with other people.
When I have a painful experience, I need comfort from other people.
Having a lot of money is not especially important to me.
I think listening to extreme opinions is a waste of time.
When making decisions, I often rely on how I feel rather than carefully considering the advantages and disadvantages.
People think that I am a very hot-tempered person.
On most days, I feel happy and optimistic.
When I see someone crying, I feel like crying too.
I think I deserve more respect than the average person.
If I had the opportunity, I would like to attend a classical music concert.
At work, I sometimes run into difficulties because I did not plan well in advance.
My usual attitude toward people who have treated me badly is to forgive and forget.
I feel that I am an unpopular person.
I would be very afraid of a dangerous situation that could physically hurt me.
If I wanted something from someone, I would laugh at their jokes even if they were not funny.
I have never really enjoyed browsing through an encyclopedia.
I do only the minimum amount of work required each day.
I comment on other people in a forgiving and generous way.
In social situations, I am usually the first person to start a conversation.
Compared with most people, I worry about fewer things.
I would never accept a bribe, even if it were very valuable or involved a large amount of money.
People often say that I have a good imagination.
I am willing to spend a great deal of time making my work as perfect as possible.
When people disagree with me, I can usually keep my opinion fairly flexible.
When I enter a new environment, the first thing I usually do is make new friends.
I can cope with difficult situations without needing emotional support from anyone.
Owning expensive luxury goods would give me great pleasure.
I like people who have unusual perspectives on things.
I have made many mistakes because I did not think carefully before acting.
Most people get angry more easily than I do.
Most people are more optimistic and energetic than I usually am.
When someone close to me leaves for a long time, I feel deeply sad.
I want other people to know that I am an important person of high status.
I do not consider myself artistic or creative.
People often say that I am a perfectionist.
Even when people make many mistakes, I rarely say harsh things to them.
Sometimes I feel that I am worthless.
Even in an emergency, I do not feel panicked.
I would not pretend to like someone in order to get that person to help me.
I find philosophical discussions boring.
I like doing whatever comes to mind rather than following a plan.
When people tell me that I am wrong, my first reaction is usually to argue with them.
In a group, I am often the person who speaks on behalf of the group.
Even in situations that make most people sentimental, I can remain unemotional.
If I were certain I would never be caught, I would be tempted to use counterfeit money.
